rationale: Independent reading: held EO 12488 (49 FR 38525) sec. 1 replaces subsection (g) of sec. 109 of Part I of EO 11157 'as amended' (toxic-fuels hazardous-duty definition); sec. 2 effective Oct. 1, 1983; no own term or savings clause; a pure amendment whose text lives in EO 11157. Held EO 13294 (68 FR 15919, page 3 of the held extract; signed Mar. 28, 2003) sec. 2: 'Executive Order 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, and Executive Order 11800 of August 17, 1974, as amended, are hereby revoked.' Revocation of the parent 'as amended' reaches the 109(g) text inserted by EO 12488 (whole_via_parent; 13294 does not name 12488, stated openly). Refutation attempts: right instrument (sec. 2 quoted correctly; page 1 of the extract is EO 13293, not relied on); no savings clause; no own term. D6: held amendments EO 12573, 12762 and 12935 touch other sections of EO 11157, not 109(g); a corpus search finds no held order naming EO 12488 or EO 13294 apart from themselves, and nothing restores EO 11157. No later event ignored. NO upheld. D6 answer: no later event ignored.
